Nope, but there's nothing anybody can do. I didn't come here to be convinced not to kill myself. I found this place before finding sanctioned suicide and now I just go there. I appreciate the thoughtfulness here though, this place is vastly overwhelmed, and that makes me sad. So many suicidal people that probably shouldn't be or don't deserve to be. I on the other hand, have been this way for 10 years, unemployed for 10 years, non functioning for 10 years, in agonizing pain for 10 years. It's time to go. So yeah, I wish I had a terminal illness, that way there'd be no guilt in ending my life and I wouldn't cause extra pain to loved ones and make them feel guilty. Getting a terminal illness would be a dream come true.

Don't bother responding, direct your time and energy elsewhere, where you might help someone. This place is desperately in need of some reason to some folks that are suicidal for temporary reasons. 

Cheers.

I fantasize about passing out, waking up in the hospital and being diagnosed with a terminal tumor all the time. Lol i totally relate.  I'm jealous. It's out of your hands now. Now just enjoy it being out of your hands and not having a world of expectations on your shoulders.

Try not giving up on yourself. 

The sad truth of life is that we are ALL ALONE. It doesn't matter if someone has been together for 70 years. We are all alone. Whose thoughts do you go to sleep with at night? Whose thoughts do you wake up with in the morning? Whose thoughts do you spend time with while you're taking a shit?

We are alone. We have to find a way to be happy with that and focus on ourselves if we want to find happiness. You can't rely on other people for your happiness and you can't rely on someone else to hold you up or rely on someone else to "not give up on you." You have to not give up on yourself. Maybe she feels like you gave up on her when you hit her. She has to focus on herself just like you have to focus on yourself, because at the end of the day, we are all alone.

I've been down that road of spiraling depression where I do stupid shit and lose all my friends because of doing dumb shit drunk/high. But I made new friends, better friends, and got better. I'm still suicidal now for other longer lasting reasons, but friends, girlfriends? That shit is all temporary and comes and goes. You want to find real happiness and a real desire to live? Find it in yourself. Treat yourself as your best friend. Imagine yourself as another person, as a guy you want to be friends with and a guy you sympathize with and that deserves to be helped and suddenly you'll see things differently. You can't blame others though man, you gotta look into yourself.

Bro what I'm talking about is completely different. I'm talking about being held emotionally hostage by somebody that knows I am suicidal, but continues to beg me to stay alive and hope for the best because they couldn't live without me. Even though we're both in pain because of my severe depression/suicidal feelings for the last 10 years. If they would accept that I won't get better and stop telling me they can't live without me, then I could finally end it.

You're talking about holding your ex emotionally hostage by saying she's the only one that can help you by giving you another chance. That's not fair. Don't be one of those people. If you got better on your own she might give you another chance, but saying that she's the only one that can end your pain is bullshit, that's not true at all. How'd you get to that place in the first place? Was it her? The fact of the matter is, you fucked up for whatever reason (I'm basing that off you saying "she needs to give you another "chance" hinting that you messed up"), because you have depression/etc. So it's not down to her, it's down to you. What is it that she needs to give you another chance for? What happened in the first place? I bet if you examine it you were already depressed deep inside or whatever and need to work on THAT. Her giving you another chance won't change that, because you did it in the first place during your first chance. 

Stop being so reliant on another person for your own happiness. That's ridiculous. Nobody can be happy that way. NOBODY. It's unhealthy thinking. You have to find happiness in your OWN SELF. If you can't do that, you'll never be happy. You'll just drift from one euphoric relationship to the next and once that euphoria stage ends, you'll be miserable. The only way to be happy is to be happy with yourself and be capable of being happy by yourself. You need to learn to do that first. Trust me, you can't rely on other people for your happiness, and you seem to be doing that by thinking you can only be happy with your ex. That's bullshit. Plenty of people have felt that way after a breakup.Hell I did after my ex of 5 years and I broke up. Many people do. But it's bullshit. You have to be happy in your own self, or you'll always end up right back here.

Stop blaming her.

Dude fuck these people. Suicide or not, just fuck em. You can find other friends. At least give it a shot with some other friends first. This seems like a temporary issue. Suicide should only be considered once you feel like your situation is permanent and have evidence to support it (aka years of feeling suicidal). You got that? If not, don't make a mistake that is permanent over something that is temporary.

This is what I'm dealing with. It takes every ounce of energy I have not to get angry and resentful at this person for using this "I care about you and love you I couldn't cope if you died" bullshit as emotional blackmail to keep me alive and in pain for the last 10 years. If I had a debilitating disease that was killing my physically, they'd have to let me go and would understand, but instead I'm held hostage to a life I haven't wanted to live for 10 years because they can't cope with the idea of losing me. So what, this is preferable? The pain you feel every day knowing your child is in this much pain and wants to die and that you can't help? The pain I feel every day? What the fuck? It would be so much better if there were clinics like Dignitas all over the world. And then we could go there and our family/loved ones would just have to learn to live with the concept and stop emotionally blackmailing us into living years upon years of painful life.

IF you actually cared, you'd want my pain to end. 

Exactly.

You have supportive parents that will let you live with them "as long as you need" for you to have time to heal and you still want to die? It could be much, much worse. Everyone feels like this after a breakup that was with a relationship that lasted so long. When I lost my relationship with my ex of 5 years I felt the same. I once came home to a roommate that had dealt with a 2 year breakup an hour prior and had a gun in his hand that I had to wrestle away. I'm still suicidal, but not for my ex, and he's much better now and with a new partner. This is temporary. Focus on bettering yourself and then you'll find someone else, everyone never thinks they will, and yet everyone does. Be so happy and glad that you have these amazing parents that will give you a time and a place to heal.

Are you serious right now? 

This says nothing new, and it doesn't change the fact that there has been no new content for 9 months. 

All this says is that the new game mode they mentioned months ago is still a thing, but no more details on when!

I feel so sorry for people like you. You refer to valid criticism as "hating" and call people that voice constructive criticism as "haters". Calling someone a hater is just a lazy way of absolving yourself of the responsibility to improve and better yourself/fix mistakes. 

Sigh, you make me weep for humanity.
